admin_code: matched by folded name (strip leading Tỉnh/Thành phố/TP.) against admin_units v2 province docs (provider='provinces-api', format='admin', meta.level='province', version==2 preferred) present in the SAME db — the only hermetic reading of the contract, since admin_units.py holds no static list. Fresh scratch dbs therefore yield admin_code=None until admin_units is ingested there; tested both ways.
Document provider='gisdata' (url scheme vn://boundary, format 'boundary'); spec didn't pin the provider string — documented in module docstring.
centroid: bbox-center -> 100x100 grid (spec) -> extra deterministic scanline-intersection fallback so thin/concave shapes can never round-trip-fail (needle test covered).
locate prefilters by document-meta bbox so only candidate geometries get parsed; falls back to all rows when meta missing.
area_km2 is a planar shoelace approximation scaled by km/deg at the bbox-center latitude (documented approximation, not the source Dtich_km2 land area).
